scientific_integrity: Analytic proof under all equal-marginal jointly Gaussian covariance designs, including singular ones; 2,044 finite checks supplement but do not prove the theorem.
scientific_limitations: One-shot scalar three-level geometric signal, exact arithmetic, fixed nonzero amplitude, Gaussian equal-variance errors; no extension to regularized estimators or general iterative stochastic dynamics.
title: Complete Gaussian correlation rigidity for noisy Aitken extrapolation
